story_facts_verified.weekly_new_residential_units: Week-start (residential units = 1-3 family + multifamily): Jul 27 392, Aug 3 90, Aug 10 13, Aug 17 230, Aug 24 26, Aug 31 8, Sep 7 12, Sep 14 21, Sep 21 188 (latest complete week, issued 2026-09-21 to 2026-09-27).
story_facts_verified.latest_week_breakdown: 168 of 188 units are nine multifamily new-structure permits at Presley Hope Place, ZIP 43081 (three at 24 units, six at 16 units = 168); the other 20 units are 1-3 family/duplex permits spread across ZIPs 43085 (6), 43205 (3), 43206 (3), 43211 (2), 43119 (2), 43110 (2), 43228 (1), 43123 (1).
story_facts_verified.year_over_year: Same week 2025 (2025-09-22 to 2025-09-28): 99 residential units (13 one-to-three-family, 86 multifamily). 188 vs 99 = +89, about +90 percent.
story_facts_verified.year_to_date_through_sep_28: 3,968 multifamily units, 663 one-to-three-family units, 512 commercial units (new-structure permits).
story_facts_verified.original_contributions: Week-over-week and year-over-year comparison; ZIP-level geographic breakdown; reproducible isolation of the single Presley Hope Place cluster (168 of 188 units) that drives the week's total.
